user.title: Connect to PLOC
user.description: Sign in with your PLOC account email and password. The integration then activates PLOUD access for Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew PLOC authentication
reauth_confirm.description: PLOUD access needs to be renewed. Enter your PLOC account credentials again to restore the connection with Home Assistant.

error.invalid_auth: PLOC authentication or PLOUD activation failed. Check the Home Assistant log for the failing stage and technical details.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the PLOC service. Check the Internet connection and try again.

init.title: Synchronization settings
init.description: Set the synchronization interval and the PLOUD response language. Automatic mode uses the Home Assistant country (French for francophone countries, English otherwise). You can override it by selecting French or English.

get_inventory.name: Get inventory
get_inventory.description: Return wines in stock, unplaced bottles and movement anomalies, without creating entities.

search.name: Search
search.description: Match wine name, appellation, region, country, grape or cuvée.
